en.sayed-ali-raza: The position of the head of government is that of the thread for beads, as it connects them and keeps them together.
If the thread is broken, they will disperse and be lost, and will never come together again.
The Arabs today, even though small in number are big because of Islam and strong because of unity.
You should remain like the axis for them, and rotate the mill (of government) with (the help of) the Arabs, and be their root. Avoid battle,
because if you leave this place the Arabs will attack you from all sides and directions till the unguarded places left behind by you will become more important than those before you.
